body: where Is Love in the Search for and Discovery of Enlightenment? Q: Where is Love in ihe search for and discovery of Enlightenment? A: At the beginning, at the middle, and at the end. Q: Can you say more than that? A; How is it possible to say more than that? Love is the source, Love is the vehicle. Love is the prime mover and the prime doer. Love is the source of Enlightenment. The expression of Enlightenment is Love. The source of Love and the source of Enlightenment are one and the same. 1 5 2
